capabilities: provide SRD monster content as a base for your own monsters
extras: The README is mostly template boilerplate (manual install steps and an optional ESLint section) with only one sentence on what the plugin actually does; it references API documentation elsewhere.
problem: Obsidian cannot display 13th Age statblock syntax as formatted monster blocks, so game masters work with unstyled text.
summary: Renders 13th Age tabletop RPG statblocks in notes and includes SRD monster content as a starting point.
